evidence.excerpt: Introducing Zenbu.js - The JavaScript framework for hackable software Zenbu.js lets you build applications that can be edited by your users. I was motivated to build Zenbu.js because I wanted to edit the software I use with my coding agents. The problem with current applications is that they ship frozen source code that cannot be modified When you install a Zenbu.js app, you are essentially cloning a git repo onto your computer, and running it in development mode.
